def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at the full-width separator into two equal panels. Find their
    # unique shared color; highlight aligned cells where both panels show it.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h - 1 and r == h - r - 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    assert len(shared) == 1
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(sep)]
